BIG CHANGE: SNOW (held) jumped to rank #2 from #15 last week. It is back inside the top-5 hold line, so the plan is now to KEEP it, not sell it. ~$344, +4.1% in USD. Insider sales and the ASOS breach claim (Snowflake says there was no compromise) are worth watching but are not red flags.
Ranking: CRWD #1 (up from #8), SNOW #2, DELL #3, DDOG #4, AMD #5. MU dropped to #6 and ALAB to #7.
Today's catch-up list shows ALAB (#7) and DELL (#3). Skip ALAB (outside the top 5). DELL is fine once the currency route is set.
System's simulated account: -1.1% (DELL +1.7%, ALAB -1.5%, MU -4.2%). You +0.3%, S&P +0.3%.
